Hi Lana — great to meet you over email. Thanks for sending the example. Short answers up front: hybrid (portal preferred, email fallback accepted) and the columns you listed cover >95% of cases. Below is the minimal schema we need plus a few operational expectations so your billing team can map fields precisely.

Required (minimal line-level schema)
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd)
- po_number (if the spend is PO-controlled; if not, leave blank)
- line_id (unique per invoice row)
- description
- quantity
- unit_price (decimal)
- line_tax (decimal)
- line_total (decimal)
- currency (ISO 4217)

Optional but strongly recommended
- service_period_start / service_period_end (yyyy-mm-dd)
- vendor_contact_email
- remit_address_id (if you maintain multiple remit addresses)

Operational notes
- Portal: Single-row CSV/Excel upload is preferred for high volume. If you use the portal, we automatically PO-stamp if the po_number matches an open PO.
- Email fallback: PDFs attached to invoices@redwood.com are accepted but must include all invoice-level fields on the first page (invoice #, invoice date, total, PO #). Attachments must be named: clearline_INV_<invoice_number>.pdf to help reconciliation.
- Attachments: If there's supporting backup (timesheets, delivery confirmation) include them as separate attachments named with the invoice number and a short suffix.
- Currency mismatches: If a currency on the invoice differs from the PO, our AP workflow will route for manual review and payment can be delayed until clarified.

Next steps
1) I can share a one-page intake checklist and a sample template (CSV + Excel) — see attached sample_invoice_template.xlsx.
2) If you want, we can schedule a 30-min mapping call with your billing ops this week to align column mappings and naming conventions.

CC'ing Marissa (AP lead) and Ben (vendor onboarding owner) to confirm operational SLAs.

Thanks Jonas — this is perfect and very clear. A few clarifications from AP side:

- PO stamping: if Clearline sends a PDF without a PO number in the header, we will not auto-stamp; AP needs either the PO on the invoice or a written PO release.
- Late / partial payments: our payment engine supports partial payments per invoice row; please ensure line_total math reconciles exactly to the invoice total.
- Duplicate prevention: include an invoice_number and vendor_tax_id (if available) — this reduces false duplicates in our system.
